data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Rafaelia is a variant of the name Raphael, which means 'God heals'. In Christian tradition, Raphael is an archangel associated with healing and protection. For women named Rafaelia, this name symbolizes the divine power of healing and nurturing. The name Rafaelia carries the meaning “Healer of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rafaelia usually hope their child will grow to embody healer of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
